related.title: Wendelstein 7-X 三維仿星器
related.transfer: 可遷移「磁壓與比壓」與「脈衝能量與排熱」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；Wendelstein 7-X 三維仿星器的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Magnetic pressure and beta" and "Pulse energy and heat removal" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Wendelstein 7-X three-dimensional stellarator must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦連續螺旋線圈的超導仿星器：線圈繞製、長時間放電、密度極限與負離子中性束；Wendelstein 7-X 三維仿星器則以最佳化仿星器的定量檢核：非平面線圈、製造公差與磁場誤差、島偏濾器與長脈衝為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A superconducting stellarator with continuous helical coils: coil winding, long discharges, the density limit and negative-ion neutral beams; Wendelstein 7-X three-dimensional stellarator centres on quantitative checks of an optimised stellarator: non-planar coils, manufacturing tolerance and field error, island divertor and long pulses, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」與「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「電子迴旋共振與加熱頻率」的模型移到Wendelstein 7-X 三維仿星器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「脈衝能量與排熱」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Device size and plasma volume" and "Device size and plasma volume".
Move the model of "Electron cyclotron resonance and heating frequency" to Wendelstein 7-X three-dimensional stellarator, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Pulse energy and heat removal", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「磁壓與比壓」與「脈衝能量與排熱」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；Wendelstein 7-X 三維仿星器的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Magnetic pressure and beta" and "Pulse energy and heat removal" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Wendelstein 7-X three-dimensional stellarator must be respecified.

history.title: LHD 大型螺旋裝置
history.text: 1990 年計畫開始建造；1998 年第一個電漿；2012 年創下 3.36 GJ 的注入能量紀錄；2017 年開始氘實驗。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1990: Construction of the project began. 1998: First plasma. 2012: The record of 3.36 GJ injected energy was set. 2017: Deuterium experiments began. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
